thread:
Jordan: FYI customer BrightDocs reporting 504/timeouts from hosted API during their nightly indexing job. They get long tails ~20-30s; started ~2026-02-15T03:12Z, spikes every 5–10m.
Nina: Oncall jumping in. Any alerts? ticket link?
ops-bot: ALERT: ingress_queue_depth = 1824 (threshold 1500) on region-us-west-2 for service=hosted-inference at 2026-02-15T03:12:36Z
Olivia: I'm seeing continuous_batching_pending_tokens climb and batcher_backlog_ms spiking to 4.2s on several hosts. p95 latency at gateway shows 14s → 28s during spikes.
Kevin: Looks like queue depth limit hit and batchers are accumulating lots of tiny partial requests (short sequences). Continuous batching flush not happening quickly enough; backlog prevents new requests from being scheduled so gateway times out.
Sam: Customer provided a repro curl they run in a tight loop. Posting snippet:

```bash
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"short prompt"}' &
done
```

Jordan: they claim they didn't change client; workload is many small requests in parallel. They saw a bunch of 502/504 and then requests start getting early rejected with 429s.
Nina: Can we capture gateway logs + batcher traces for the 03:12 window? I'll need request ids and tenant id.
Olivia: Grabbed sample from host i-0bcd: gateway log snippet:

```text
2026-02-15T03:12:34Z [gw] req_id=rd-7f3a tenant=brightdocs status=504 reason="queue_depth_exceeded" queue_depth=1824 cap=1024
2026-02-15T03:12:35Z [batcher] host=i-0bcd pending_batches=48 continuous_pending_ms=4200
2026-02-15T03:12:36Z [runtime] model=open-7b batch_size=1 token_latency=90ms
```

Olivia: kvcache_hit_rate dropped (contention on cache evictions) which increases per-token cost and memory pressure.
Kevin: Short-term mitigation options:
- decrease continuous_batching_max_wait_ms to 10 (from 50) to force earlier flushes
- increase gateway per-tenant queue cap temporarily (riskier)
- divert brightdocs to a lower-concurrency lane / standby cluster
- enable emergency partial-run fallback to the smaller quantized variant

Sam: Suggested message to BrightDocs (I can send): ask them to add jitter + exponential backoff and reduce parallel concurrency to 40 while we triage. Also include a sample retry policy.
Nina: I will try lowering max_wait_ms first. Olivia, Kevin — can you roll that config change with canary and keep an eye on p95?
Kevin: Rolling change now to canary hosts (commands):

```console
rbctl apply-config --env=prod --patch '{"continuous_batching": {"max_wait_ms": 10}}' --scope=canary
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: apply-config on canary (5 hosts)
Olivia: Canary looks better: ingress_queue_depth dropped from 1700→400 in ~60s on canary. p95 on canary down to 1800ms. Global still noisy.
Jordan: Customer confirmed reduced errors after we asked them to throttle — but still seeing occasional tails. They want permanent fix and root cause.
Olivia: Root cause hypothesis: workload pattern of many tiny requests + high concurrency pushes queue depth past per-host memory/kv eviction thresholds which slows continuous batching flush and causes prioritization thrash. Need long-term controls: smarter tenant shaping, adaptive max_wait based on queue depth, and better KV eviction policy.
Sam: Opening support ticket and sending interim guidance.
Olivia: Creating Jira INF-4281: "continuous-batcher backlog causing gateway tail timeouts for small-request workloads" — assigned to infra + runtime.
Kevin: Long-term actions I can take:
- implement adaptive flush that reduces wait when pending_tokens > X
- add tenant-specific concurrency caps and circuit-breakers
- add early-metric alert for continuous_pending_ms > 2000ms

Nina: Action items:
- Kevin: propose config spec for adaptive flush (ETA 48h)
- Olivia: collect complete traces + kvcache profiles for the incident (ETA 24h)
- Sam/Jordan: send customer mitigation + timeline
- Ops: monitor and escalate if queue_depth > 1500 again

Sam: I'll message BrightDocs now and attach suggested retry snippet + temporary concurrency limit.
Jordan: Ticket updated in Zendesk #ZD-9834. Customer asked for ETA on a permanent fix.
ops-bot: Incident annotated: severity=high, linked_ticket=INF-4281, notification=pg-alerts
Olivia: Marking this incident as "mitigated (canary config change)" but not resolved until infra changes. Will post RCA draft when available.
Nina: Thanks team — I'll stay on watch for the next 2h. If anything pops over threshold ping @oncall.
Kevin: I'll start design doc tomorrow AM. Logging follow-ups in INF-4281.

Jordan: closing loop with customer: "We mitigated immediate tail-latency by tuning batching flush and recommended client-side throttling; engineering will deliver a long-term fix (INF-4281)." :thumbsup:
